The static declaration cannot call the non-static helpers getProjVertexByIndex / getEdge, and the signatures do not match, so this will not compile. Align the declaration with the intended instance API – e.g. remove static and the owner parameter – or provide a static wrapper that casts owner to DrawViewPart*.

Update the definition to match the declaration, or update the header to the intended instance signature and adjust all call sites that previously used DrawUtil::isCosmetic*.
